items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like the “Rondo Cappricioso” and the “Caprice Brilliant” by Mendelssohn.

ctx.x: How did Professor Sims teach you? What kind of exercises or techniques or reading…
Oh, he’d teach me Bach and then I would learn pieces like Rondo Capriccioso by Mendelssohn. And things like that.
How quickly would you pick up music, was it something you just digested?
